name: Observability Stack
description: OpenTelemetry Collector + Grafana + Loki + Tempo + Prometheus + MinIO, wired together — send traces/metrics/logs to one OTLP endpoint, query all three in Grafana with datasources pre-provisioned, and drop dashboard JSON into the bundled MinIO bucket to have them auto-synced into Grafana.
author: giomartinsdev
